weakness: No MFA on the email tenant, CRM, portfolio platform, e-signature, or accounting administrator accounts; email password reused
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA with an authenticator app on all five; register a hardware key as a second method; password manager with unique passphrases
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested on all five; 2026-09-30 hardware key registered
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours); password manager about $40 a year; hardware keys about $60

weakness: No training or reporting step for business email compromise and social engineering; no callback rule
source: P07 assessment (AT-02(03) objectives); P03 G-004 G-024; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Adopt the callback rule (POL-01 7.6) with a CRM callback field; letter to clients; annual course with a business email compromise module; log and report near misses
milestones: 2026-09-30 callback rule in use and client letter sent; 2026-11-30 course completed
resources_required: Owner time; course about $100 a year

weakness: USB backup drive with every client folder is not encrypted and sits in an unlocked drawer
source: P07 assessment (SC-28(01) objectives); P03 G-015; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: Replace with an encrypted drive kept in the home safe; wipe and destroy the old drive with a record
milestones: 2026-09-30 new drive in use; old drive destroyed

weakness: No independent backup meeting the 24-hour RPO; backup copy unencrypted and overwritable
source: P07 assessment (CP-09 objectives); P03 G-003; P01 R-008 R-011
remediation_plan: Encrypted backup of mail and files to a second cloud location with 1-year retention; USB copy disconnected except during the copy; quarterly restore test
milestones: 2026-10-31 cloud backup running; 2026-12-31 first quarterly restore test

weakness: No vendor list or review; compliance consultant without security terms; client data in a consumer AI assistant
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-028 G-029 G-030; P01 R-006 R-007
remediation_plan: Vendor list (POL-01 Appendix A); pre-adoption checklist; security and confidentiality terms with the compliance consultant; stop and clear the AI assistant (P10); request CRM and e-signature assurance
milestones: 2026-09-30 AI history deleted and training turned off; 2026-10-31 terms signed and vendor list complete
resources_required: Owner time; possible fee from the compliance consultant

weakness: Sign-ins, mailbox rules, and platform activity never reviewed; unknown forwarding rule found
source: P07 assessment (AU-06 objectives); P03 G-021; P01 R-002
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day using a one-page checklist; log each review; review weekly for 3 months after any incident or near miss

weakness: No incident reporting steps or notification contact list
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-034 G-037; P01 R-010
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; print contacts; name breach counsel in advance; add prompt-notice terms at vendor renewals
milestones: 2026-09-30 contacts printed and runbook walked through with the IT consultant

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
source: P07 assessment (RA-03d. and RA-03f.); P03 G-011
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual July review and change triggers; first update July 2027
